verdict.rationale: Mintlify's AI works on the user's own content: the editor agent can leave comments and suggestions on pages (docs-26), and the Mintlify agent researches and proposes documentation changes as reviewable PRs (docs-4, docs-5). The analytics dashboard tracks assistant conversations, search queries and reader feedback (docs-19), and Enterprise lists "Advanced insights" (docs-61), but nothing shows AI generating insights from that analytics data. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or summaries from analytics, conversation or feedback data; detail on what "Advanced insights" includes; independent or hands-on corroboration.
